verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a sequential pipeline of skills that read each other's outputs. It shows no general capability for applying one operation across many user-selected items at once. The rebrand sweep that finds the original's name 'anywhere in your code' is a specific de-branding check, an adjacent feature rather than a bulk-operations capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
